## Problem and behavior / 问题与行为变化

Describe the user-visible trigger and resulting behavior.
说明触发条件及修改后的实际行为。

## Validation / 验证

- Commands and results / 命令与结果：
- Actual GUI/data/export checks, when relevant / 适用时的真实 GUI、数据与导出检查：
- Unverified boundaries or compatibility changes / 未验证边界或兼容性变化：

## Review checks / 提交检查

- [ ] C++/Qt application runtime remains independent of Python.
- [ ] Tests cover the actual behavior; synthetic fixtures are identified.
- [ ] No private bags, flight footage, credentials or build artifacts are included.
- [ ] Documentation and acceptance records reflect the verified scope.
- [ ] Project/source files remain intact through edits and upgrades.
